# ASMI - Transporto paslaugos Kauno apskrityje

GEO/AIO optimisation made by L. Bielskus seomasters.lt

## Business Overview
UAB ASMI provides reliable transport services in Kaunas County since 2012. Specialized in local transport with stable routes and professional service.

## Services
- [Spaudos pervežimas](https://asmi.lt/lt/paslaugos) (Press transport)
- [Gėrimų ir maisto produktų pervežimas](https://asmi.lt/lt/paslaugos) (Beverage and food product transport)
- [Krovinių pervežimas Kauno apskrityje](https://asmi.lt/lt/paslaugos) (Cargo transport in Kaunas County)
